namespace_boundary: Explicit import range; range.* utilities. No canonical Range namespace or RangeError changes.
cursor: range.Cursor<T>: independent Copy state, private fields, fused next/next_back

contracts.RangeDirection: The stored ascending or descending direction, independent of whether the sequence is empty.
contracts.RangeDirection.Ascending: Values advance toward larger integers by a positive unsigned magnitude.
contracts.RangeDirection.Descending: Values advance toward smaller integers by a positive unsigned magnitude.
contracts.RangeOperationError: Failures of source-only ordinal and step helpers; distinct from canonical RangeError.
contracts.RangeOperationError.OutOfBounds: The requested ordinal is outside the sequence, or a split index exceeds its cardinality.
contracts.RangeOperationError.OutOfBounds.index: The original usize ordinal supplied by the caller.
contracts.RangeOperationError.InvalidStep: A zero multiplicative step factor is invalid, including for empty descriptors.
contracts.RangeOperationError.StepOverflow: The product of the current magnitude and factor does not fit the element unsigned magnitude type.
contracts.RangeOperationError.code: Return a stable allocation-free code for this source error carrier.
contracts.RangeOperationError.message: Return an allocation-free English description for this source error carrier.
contracts.empty: Return the canonical ascending half-open zero-to-zero descriptor for an integer T.
contracts.direction: Inspect the stored direction without enumerating values; emptiness does not erase the direction.
contracts.contains: Check directional bounds and step divisibility in O(1), including signed numeric extremes.
contracts.equal: Compare bounds, inclusion, unsigned magnitude and direction; descriptors can differ while yielding equal sequences.
contracts.first: Return the first yielded integer, or None when the finite descriptor is empty.
contracts.get: Return the integer at a zero-based usize ordinal, or None; validate the ordinal before multiplication.
contracts.last: Return the last reachable integer in O(1), without forming a cardinality that can overflow u128.
contracts.at: Return an ordinal value or RangeOperationError.OutOfBounds containing the unchanged caller index.
contracts.reverse: Reverse the finite sequence using closed actual reached endpoints and the opposite direction; never negate a step.
contracts.take: Keep at most count leading values in O(1); zero yields canonical empty and finite cuts use a reached closed endpoint.
contracts.skip: Remove up to count leading values in O(1); cuts use actual reached closed endpoints and never form MAX+1.
contracts.split_at: Return prefix and suffix descriptors when index is no greater than cardinality, without enumeration or count overflow.
contracts.sequence_equal: Compare yielded sequences in O(1); all empty sequences compare equal and singleton step/direction differences are ignored.
contracts.Cursor: An independent, copyable, allocation-free, double-ended fused cursor over a finite integer sequence.
contracts.Cursor.new: Own a private cursor state initialized from a Copy descriptor; the caller can continue using its original descriptor.
contracts.Cursor.is_exhausted: Report whether all values were consumed; exhaustion remains true after later next or next_back calls.
contracts.Cursor.next: Yield from the front and advance only when another value remains; return None permanently after exhaustion.
contracts.Cursor.next_back: Yield from the back, sharing remaining bounds with next; never advance beyond the final remaining value.
contracts.iter: Create an independent forward cursor without borrowing or changing the original descriptor.
contracts.rev_iter: Create an independent cursor over the reversed finite sequence without enumerating or allocating.
contracts.step_by: Multiply the unsigned magnitude by a positive same-width factor; return InvalidStep or StepOverflow before arithmetic.
contracts.RangeArrayError: Failures of fixed-array materialization; distinct from canonical RangeError, which is unchanged.
contracts.RangeArrayError.CountOverflow: The finite range cardinality cannot be represented as usize, before any explicit output initialization.
contracts.RangeArrayError.LengthMismatch: The representable range cardinality differs from the requested compile-time array extent.
contracts.RangeArrayError.LengthMismatch.expected: The compile-time usize array extent supplied as the first generic argument.
contracts.RangeArrayError.LengthMismatch.actual: The exact representable usize cardinality of the input sequence.
contracts.RangeArrayError.code: Return the stable allocation-free code of this source array-materialization error.
contracts.RangeArrayError.message: Return an allocation-free English description of this source array-materialization error.
contracts.collect_vector: Materialize integer Copy values after exact cardinality and byte-size checks. Map count overflow to CollectionError.SizeOverflow; reserve output once, preserve the input descriptor and release owned output on failure. Empty output performs no allocation.
contracts.to_array: Materialize exactly N integer Copy values into inline storage; N is the first const generic argument and T is inferred. Validate count before explicit repeated-array initialization. Return source RangeArrayError on count overflow or length mismatch. The current aggregate Result ABI still reserves/copies/zero-initializes O(N) storage even on an error; no heap buffer is allocated.
